crossRefs.note: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.

translations.web: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
translations.bsb: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.
translations.kjv: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
translations.asv: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
